JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  u.full_name, 
  le.ip_address, 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN le.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_attempts, 
  COUNT(t.txn_id) AS transactions
FROM 
  users u
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
  JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE 
  le.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
  AND UPPER(le.status) LIKE '%FAILED%'
  AND u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH')
  AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' 
  OR UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%'
GROUP BY 
  u.full_name, 
  le.ip_address, 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN le.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) > 10
  OR COUNT(t.txn_id) > 10
  OR (COUNT(CASE WHEN le.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(le.event_id)) > 0.1
  OR (COUNT(t.txn_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-30 days'))) > 0.1
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.
